# Contract failures against upstream Hermes that are known and accepted.
#
# Without this the drift lane names the same failure on every run, and within a
# week nobody reads it -- at which point the next genuinely new break arrives as
# one more line in a channel that has been failing since day one.
#
# Format: one entry per line, `<test id> <fingerprint>`.
#
# The fingerprint is a short, stable digest of the failure's own text, not just
# the test id. A baselined test whose assertion or error has *changed* is a new
# break wearing a known name, and matching on the name alone would file it as
# expected. Change the failure, and it stops matching.
#
# Remove an entry when the underlying break is fixed. An entry that no longer
# matches any failure is reported, so this file cannot rot quietly.

tests.test_hermes_contract.HermesContractTests.test_host_tool_invocation_reaches_real_telegram_media_contract refusing-to-send-to-telegram-relay-routing
